gloss: to exchange words; to have a conversation

definitions.gloss: to exchange words; to have a conversation; to talk with each other
definitions.explanation: Describes two or more people speaking with each other. Implies a mutual exchange rather than one-sided communication. Can range from a brief greeting to a longer conversation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{短|みじか}い→短い：00510_mijikai⟧{言葉|ことば}を{交|か}わした。
examples.english: The two exchanged a few words.

examples.japanese: ⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{言葉|ことば}を{交|か}わす⟦{機会|きかい}→機会：01302_kikai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I didn't have a chance to talk with the person next to me.

examples.japanese: あいさつ⟦{程度|ていど}→程度：01468_teido⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{言葉|ことば}を{交|か}わす⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧だった。
examples.english: Our relationship was limited to exchanging greetings.

notes:
A set phrase combining ⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧ (words) with ⟦{交|か}わす→交わす：19373_kawasu⟧ (to exchange). Emphasizes the reciprocal nature of verbal communication — both parties are speaking. Often used in literary or slightly formal contexts.

USAGE:
Can describe anything from a brief exchange of greetings to a lengthy conversation. The type of exchange is often qualified: ⟦{短|みじか}い→短い：00510_mijikai⟧{言葉|ことば}を{交|か}わす (exchange a few words), ⟦{親|した}しく→親しい：02345_shitashii⟧{言葉|ことば}を{交|か}わす (chat warmly).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{短|みじか}い→短い：00510_mijikai⟧{言葉|ことば}を{交|か}わす — to exchange a few brief words
- ⟦{親|した}しく→親しい：02345_shitashii⟧{言葉|ことば}を{交|か}わす — to converse intimately
- あいさつ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{言葉|ことば}を{交|か}わす — to exchange greetings

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{会話|かいわ}→会話：01271_kaiwa⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to converse; neutral and straightforward
- ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to talk; the most common everyday expression
- ⟦{語|かた}り{合|あ}う→語り合う：03045_katariau⟧ — to talk together at length; implies deeper, more personal conversation
